Lina: Quick follow-up from all-hands on GPU supply and autoscale. Putting notes here.
Marcus: Who triggers cross-region bursts?
Shardul: Oncall + SRE. infra applies routing. We have automated alerts but human confirms.
Priya: Suggested trigger: sustained reserved GPU >= 90% for 6m AND queue growth > 20% over 10m.
Lina: Can Dedicated tenants force no failover?
Marcus: Yes, tenant config: allow_cross_region_failover=false. Default true for hosted.
Priya: Fallback order: lower-power GPU -> increased batching -> CPU-only for batch jobs -> rate limit.
Shardul: Canary: 5% for 10m; abort if latency +25% or quality drop >10%.
ops-bot: Dry-run scheduled: fallback-dryrun-2026-09-10T08:00Z in staging. Logs will be posted.
Lina: Action items: Marcus to update runbook, Priya to add canary metrics, Shardul to run dry-run. Link PRs here.
Marcus: I'll update runbook by EOD.
Priya: I'll add metrics to evals dashboard.
Lina: Thanks, adding failover rehearsal to ops drill calendar.
